metadata.sysdescription: Erebus is an Arvonian industrial-research system specialising in sophisticated AI cores, adaptive processors, and personality-matrix hardware. Its elegant public image hides a dense underworld of smugglers, covert laboratories, stolen identities, and illicit access routes.
metadata.focus: AI core production, quantum research, and information commerce

S 05.description: Unregistered station radiating industrial heat in short, carefully timed cycles; spectral traces suggest precision processor fabrication rather than ordinary mining.

Lilene Crownworks.description: Premier fabrication complex producing certified civic and naval AI cores under direct royal audit.

Sasha Memorial.description: Public memorial, diplomatic reception station, and cultural archive dedicated to Queen Sasha's early reign.

Velvet Circuit.description: Adaptive-processor works specialising in elegant low-power cores for civilian vessels and remote habitats.

Iridescent Logic.description: Research station testing optical computation, predictive navigation, and high-density personality matrices.

Serene Algorithm.description: Administrative intelligence hub coordinating traffic, customs, and commercial arbitration across Erebus.

Mirrorglass Exchange.description: Major free-trade station known for luxury organics, data brokerage, and discreet contract negotiation.

Azure Thoughtworks.description: Produces hardened navigation and tactical processors for Arvonian carriers and long-range survey craft.

Z 142.description: Faint habitat signature surrounded by passive sensor buoys; traffic approaches under tight-beam guidance and departs with altered transponder profiles.

Rosewater Habitat.description: Large residential habitat with hydroponic gardens, performance halls, schools, and family medical services.

Violet Concord.description: Neutral diplomatic station where Arvonian houses settle disputes through ceremony, mediation, and coded favours.

Ore Reaper Refinery.description: Asteroid-processing station supplying refined metals and specialist substrates to nearby AI foundries.

Silver Current.description: Quantum-component refinery producing superconductive channels and precision cooling assemblies.

Opaline Foundry.description: Heavy industrial station manufacturing core housings, power relays, and shielded computational racks.

Garden of Numbers.description: Experimental software laboratory where competing machine intelligences are trained through cooperative simulations.

E 82.description: Cold-running installation with powerful data links and almost no visible habitation emissions; likely an archive, intelligence node, or autonomous computation site.

Pearl Chorus.description: Communications and cultural broadcast station carrying news, drama, and approved machine-generated art.

Radiant Archive.description: Secure historical archive holding legal identities, family records, and licensed personality templates.

Silken Vector.description: Navigation-data exchange providing route updates, hazard forecasts, and encrypted courier services.

Amethyst Loom.description: High-security core foundry specialising in diplomatic, medical, and behavioural-analysis intelligences.

Luminous Accord.description: Public administration and arbitration station serving independent workshops and outer-system habitats.

Moonpetal Clinic.description: Advanced medical centre using diagnostic AIs, adaptive organics, and long-duration rehabilitation suites.

Z 77.description: Shielded platform embedded near mineral debris; scans indicate armoured storage cells and launch-capable internal bays inconsistent with civilian freight handling.

Crimson Synapse.description: Fast-turnaround processor plant supplying military-grade sensor interpretation and fighter-control cores.

Golden Mnemonic.description: Mnemonic engineering laboratory creating durable memory lattices for education, medicine, and exploration.

Cerulean Atelier.description: Boutique design station producing customised AI interfaces, avatar systems, and ceremonial housings.

Sapphire Bazaar.description: Busy commercial port trading quantum components, specialist organics, software licences, and luxury goods.

Whispering Gallery.description: Private conference and information-brokerage station where access depends more on reputation than credits.

Denebite Bloom.description: Denebite refinement and nano-alloy facility feeding precision electronics and high-temperature processors.

Gentle Equation.description: Standards laboratory certifying AI safety constraints, identity continuity, and legal accountability.

Embermind Forge.description: High-temperature foundry manufacturing resilient cores for industrial, mining, and military use.

Q 12.description: Irregular medical and bio-organic emissions accompany encrypted machine traffic; purpose may involve neural mapping, personality capture, or experimental rehabilitation.

CP 16.description: Low-emission structure with intermittent encrypted bursts and unusually dense internal power shielding; likely a signals-analysis or covert coordination site.

Starlace Observatory.description: Astronomical observatory mapping local nebulae, jump turbulence, and long-range signal anomalies.

Quiet Reflection.description: Secluded research habitat studying machine creativity, intuition, and non-verbal decision systems.

Harmonic Assembly.description: Assembly station integrating processors, sensors, communications suites, and personality interfaces.

Indigo Sanctuary.description: Protected retreat and convalescence station for researchers affected by prolonged neural-interface work.

Mosaic Intelligence.description: Large cooperative research complex where biological and synthetic cognition teams share facilities.

Velvet Hammer.description: Industrial repair yard known for rapid reconstruction of damaged stations, carriers, and core factories.

X 63.description: Station appears largely dormant, yet local navigation solutions show subtle artificial corrections; likely maintains a concealed beacon or route-monitoring array.

Memory Orchard.description: Living-data laboratory cultivating bio-organic memory media and adaptive neural substrates.

Gilded Current.description: Fuel-processing and power-distribution station supporting the system's dense industrial network.

Prismatic Haven.description: Civilian habitat and arts centre famous for colour-shifting architecture and machine-assisted performances.

Softlight Shipworks.description: Compact shipyard servicing Arvonian carriers, couriers, research ships, and licensed foreign vessels.

Cobalt Salon.description: Social and commercial station where contracts are negotiated through formal hospitality and public debate.

Dreamweaver Annex.description: Simulation centre training navigation, medical, and diplomatic AIs against complex social scenarios.

Merciful Engine.description: Emergency-response station coordinating rescue craft, medical teams, and disaster-management intelligences.

Orchid Relay.description: Long-range communications relay with encrypted channels linking Erebus to Arvonian political authorities.

Glasswing Habitat.description: Outer-system residential station supporting miners, fuel collectors, couriers, and independent researchers.

Aurora Crucible.description: Specialist forge producing heat-resistant quantum components and reactor-control processors.

G 60.description: High-energy cooling pulses and quantum interference suggest a prototype core foundry operating beyond normal commercial safety limits.

Measured Grace.description: Inspection and quality-assurance station responsible for certifying exported Erebus AI cores.

Ivory Lantern.description: Beacon, courier stop, and traveller refuge positioned along a difficult outer-system navigation lane.

Thousand Mirrors.description: Distributed sensor-analysis centre comparing traffic patterns, smuggling indicators, and jump-space disturbances.

Dawn Algorithm.description: Civilian processor works producing affordable educational, agricultural, and maintenance intelligences.

Living Archive.description: Restricted but acknowledged archive preserving obsolete AIs, retired personalities, and disputed legal records.

E 63.description: Minimal crew emissions, redundant communications, and tightly controlled courier visits indicate a secure data vault or clandestine command facility.

Queen's Respite.description: Quiet hospitality station used by senior engineers, diplomats, and visiting Arvonian dignitaries.

Nyx.description: Erebus's principal inhabited world, a dim temperate planet of clouded seas, luminous garden cities, and elegant Arvonian civic enclaves.

Mnemosyne.description: A cold metal-rich world ringed by foundries and data works; most certified Erebus AI cores begin their manufacture in its orbital industry.

Lethe.description: A pale gas giant whose atmosphere supplies exotic coolants and quantum feedstocks; its moons host refineries, laboratories, and restricted installations.
